title: Dashboard
content:
The Dashboard is the default screen when you open the app. It shows real-time free parking space counts for both monitored locations.
Parking Cards# Each location is shown as a parking card containing:
Element Description Location name GreenDay or Uni Wroc Free spaces count Large number showing currently available spaces ≈ indicator Shown when the value is approximated (interpolated from nearby data points) Original value Shown in parentheses below the approximated value: (orig: 23) Data age Small text showing how fresh the data is (e.g. 2m ago, just now) Approximation active hours Active only on weekdays (Mon–Fri) between 05:00 and 21:00 local time. Data Age Colour Coding# The free-spaces number changes colour based on how fresh the data is:
Colour Meaning Normal Data is fresh (< 5 minutes old) Amber/orange Data is 5–15 minutes old Red/faded Data is older than 15 minutes Refresh# The app auto-refreshes every 5 minutes. To refresh manually, click the ⟳ Refresh button in the header. All Offline# If no live data can be retrieved, a banner is shown:
⚠️ All parking lots are offline. Showing last known data.
If the value is marked with ≈, it means an approximation was applied because a nearby area’s reading was fresher. Approximation is applied only on weekdays (Mon–Fri) between 05:00 and 21:00 local time.
Header Actions (Dashboard)# Button Action ⟳ Refresh Fetch fresh data immediately 📊 Statistics Navigate to historical chart view ⚙️ Settings Open settings 🌙 / ☀️ / 🔄 Cycle theme: Light → Dark → System ☕ Buy me Open support link

title: Free Parking Monitor – User Manual
content:
Overview# Free Parking Monitor is a real-time web application that shows the current number of free parking spaces at two locations in Wrocław, Poland:
GreenDay – up to 187 spaces Uni Wroc (University of Wrocław) – up to 41 spaces The app refreshes automatically every 5 minutes and stores the last known values in your browser so you can see parking availability even if you are offline briefly.
Features at a Glance# Feature Description 🅿️ Live Dashboard Real-time free-space counts for both parking lots 📊 Statistics Historical charts showing availability over time ⚙️ Settings Personalise the app: theme, color vision mode 🔮 Predictions ‘Predictions for ’ heading (e.g. “Predictions for Monday”) and quick-glance tiles showing upcoming events and countdowns 🌙 / ☀️ / 🔄 Theme Three theme modes: Light, Dark, System 👁️ Color Vision Modes 8 accessibility palettes for different visual needs 🐛 Bug Report One-click email to report issues ☕ Support Link to support the developer Navigation# The app has three main screens accessible from the header:
Screen How to reach Dashboard Default screen; click 🏠 Dashboard from any other screen Statistics Click 📊 Statistics in the header Settings Click ⚙️ Settings in the header Sections# Dashboard — Live parking availability Statistics — Historical charts Settings — Theme and accessibility options

title: Settings
content:
The Settings screen lets you personalise the Free Parking Monitor app and get support.
Navigate to Settings by clicking ⚙️ Settings in the header from any screen.
Sections# App Info# Shows the current app version and a brief description of the application.
Color Vision Mode# Adjust the indicator colours (progress bars, status colours) for your colour vision needs.
Eight modes are available:
Mode Description Normal (default) Standard green / orange / red palette Protan Protanopia / Protanomaly – reduced red sensitivity; uses yellow/amber + blue Deutan Deuteranopia / Deuteranomaly – green/red confusion; uses blue/orange/purple Tritan Tritanopia / Tritanomaly – blue/yellow confusion; uses green/magenta/amber Achrom Achromatopsia (monochromacy) – strong grayscale with monotonic luminance HiCon High contrast – crisp tones for low-vision users LowVis Low vision – highly saturated palette (AMD, diabetic retinopathy) Cataracts Cataracts – cooler, higher-contrast tones How to Select# Click any mode button. The active mode is highlighted with a coloured border. Your selection is saved automatically in your browser (key: parking_cb_mode). The colour change takes effect immediately on the Dashboard and Statistics chart. Compatibility with Theme# All color vision modes work with both Light and Dark themes – each mode has optimised colour variants for both backgrounds.
Feedback & Support# 🐛 Report a Bug# Click the Report a Bug button to open a pre-filled email draft in your default email client. The email includes:
App version Browser user-agent string A structured template for describing the issue and steps to reproduce Send the email to: piotereks+free-parking-bugs@gmail.com
☕ Buy me a coffee# Click to open the developer’s support page (buycoffee.to/piotereks) in a new tab.
Header Actions (Settings)# Button Action 🏠 Dashboard Return to live dashboard 🌙 / ☀️ / 🔄 Cycle theme: Light → Dark → System ☕ Buy me Open support link Theme Modes# The theme toggle button cycles through three modes:
Icon shown Current mode Next mode on click 🌙 Light Dark 🔄 Dark System ☀️ System Light System mode automatically follows your operating system’s dark/light preference and updates in real time if you change the OS setting.
Your theme choice is saved in localStorage under the key parking_theme.

title: Statistics
content:
Statistics# The Statistics screen shows a time-series chart of historical parking availability for both GreenDay and Uni Wroc.
Chart Overview# The chart plots free parking spaces over time. Two lines are drawn:
Line Parking lot First colour (default: green) GreenDay Second colour (default: blue) Uni Wroc Interacting with the Chart# Zooming# Scroll (or pinch on touch devices) to zoom in/out on the time axis. Use the zoom slider at the bottom of the chart to pan and zoom. Zoom state is preserved when you switch colour palettes. Tooltip# Hover (or tap) over the chart to see exact values for both parking lots at a given time. Colour Palette Selector# The Palette selector in the header (visible on wider screens) lets you choose from four built-in colour schemes:
Palette GreenDay colour Uni Wroc colour Neon (default) 🟢 Neon green 🔵 Cyan blue Classic 🔵 Blue 🟡 Amber Cyberpunk 💠 Cyan 🟣 Magenta Modern 🟢 Emerald 🔵 Indigo Color Vision Mode override: When a non-normal color vision mode is selected in Settings, the chart automatically switches to a CB-aware palette regardless of the palette selector. The CB palette is derived from the active color-blindness mode and current theme (light/dark).
Event Crossings# The chart displays vertical lines that mark specific moments; each colour has a defined meaning:
Orange: time when GreenDay (GD) free spaces reached zero. Red: time when both GreenDay and Uni have no free places (total free = 0). Blue: time when the first places free up in GreenDay — a “risky” reopening where freed places may be quickly taken. Green: time when sufficient free capacity expected to remain available. These event lines correspond to the prediction types surfaced in the Predictions panel. The app shows four prediction tiles that summarize upcoming events:
GD=0 — predicted time when GreenDay is expected to reach zero free spaces. All=0 — predicted time when total free spaces (both locations) are expected to reach zero. Try FREE — predicted time when a small number of places are expected to become available. Safe FREE — predicted time when a more stable amount of free capacity is expected. Each prediction tile displays the event time formatted as hh:mm. When a predicted time is within two hours, a live minute-countdown is shown on the tile; the countdown updates in real time. The countdown window is two hours by default. The times shown come from the model’s median estimate.
Predictions header# The Predictions panel heading now displays the full weekday name. For example: Predictions for Monday.
Symbols Toggle# Click the Symbols button to show or hide data point markers on the chart lines.
Header Actions (Statistics)# Button Action 🏠 Dashboard Return to live dashboard ⚙️ Settings Open settings 🌙 / ☀️ / 🔄 Cycle theme ☕ Buy me Open support link

title: Theme Index
content:
HUGO BOOK Hugo documentation theme as simple as plain book
Hugo0.146 LicenseMIT
Explore What Hugo-Book Theme Is# Hugo book theme is primarily designed to create technical documentation sites that are easy to read, write, navigate and maintain. It is an attempt to create a sustainable web project.
What Hugo-Book Theme Is Not# Book theme is not trying to implement all features but to create a starting point. It is mostly feature complete and gets updated and improved to stay relevant with Hugo and modern web.
Probably fast# Build on Hugo static site generator. “The world’s fastest framework for building websites”.
50% JS free# All important features are working even with JavaScript disabled in browser, including interactive shortcodes.
Minimalistic# For real, it is very minimalistic, black on white. No extra tools are needed to build the site, only Hugo. No heavy JS or CSS frameworks included.
Shortcodes# Pretty good shortcodes are included to enhance markup files: Columns, Cards, Tabs, Images, Asciinema, KaTex, Mermaid and others.
Even more# Do people actually read these? I thought it was just a visual filler. But there is full-text search and multi-language support.
Made to be extendable# There are multiple points to inject own styles and templates to make your documentation your own.

title: Privacy Policy for Free Parking App
content:
Effective Date: January 18, 2026
This Privacy Policy describes how the Free Parking App (“we,” “us,” or “our”) collects, uses, and shares information when you use our mobile application (the “App”). By using the App, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.
1. Information We Collect# 1.1 Information You Provide# We do not require you to create an account or provide personal information to use the App. 1.2 Information Collected Automatically# App Usage Data: When you open the App, we automatically collect the following information:
Timestamp of app launch Application version Operating system version (e.g., Android version) Device model (e.g., phone model) Browser agent text (for web users) Purpose: This data is used solely for app usage analytics, diagnostics, and to improve the service. No session information is stored, and we do not combine these data points to identify users.
Storage: This information is stored securely in the app owner’s Google personal account and is not shared with any third parties.
Local Data Only: The App caches parking availability data in your device’s local storage (localStorage on web, AsyncStorage on mobile) to improve performance. This data includes parking spot counts and timestamps from publicly available sources and is never transmitted to our servers.
No Location Tracking: The App does not request or collect your device location. Parking data shown is from public APIs and not personalized to your location.
1.3 Third-Party Services# AdMob (Non-Personalized Ads with Campaign Analytics): The mobile app displays advertisements through Google AdMob configured to show non-personalized ads only (requestNonPersonalizedAdsOnly: true). While ads are not personalized to you, AdMob does collect data for advertising purposes: What AdMob Collects: Device information (device type, OS version, screen size, language) IP address (for general location, ad delivery, and fraud prevention) Ad interactions (impressions, clicks, conversions) App usage data related to ad performance How AdMob Uses This Data: Display non-personalized advertisements (not based on your interests or browsing history) Campaign performance tracking and analytics Ad fraud prevention and security Aggregate reporting for advertisers Important: Even though ads are non-personalized, Google collects analytics data to measure ad campaign effectiveness and improve ad services. For more information, see Google’s Privacy Policy and How Google uses information from sites or apps that use our services. Public Parking Data Sources: The App fetches real-time parking availability from public APIs (zaparkuj.pl). This data is publicly available and contains no personal information. We do not control these third-party services. 2. How We Use Information# The App’s core functionality operates without collecting personal information:
Display Parking Data: Fetch and display real-time parking availability from public sources. Local Caching: Store parking data locally on your device for faster loading and offline access. Ad Display: Show non-personalized advertisements through Google AdMob (mobile app only). What We Do NOT Do:
We do NOT collect, analyze, or store user behavior data (such as actions taken within the app, navigation, or feature usage patterns). We do NOT track your location, movements, or app usage patterns. We do NOT sell, rent, or share any personal information with third parties. We do NOT create user profiles or identify individual users. Device name, OS version, and browser model are not considered personal information, and no session information is stored nor is any combination of this information performed. Note: While we do collect basic app usage data as described above, we do not collect analytics or personal information. Google AdMob collects data for ad campaign performance, reporting, and fraud prevention as described above.
3. Sharing of Information# Google AdMob: As described above, the mobile app uses AdMob for non-personalized advertisements. Google may collect basic device information as described in their privacy policy. No Analytics Providers: We do not use analytics services or share data with analytics providers. Legal Requirements: We may disclose information if required by law, but since we don’t collect personal data, there is minimal information to disclose. No Data Sharing: We do not share, sell, or transmit any user data to third parties. All parking data displayed comes from public sources and is not user-specific. 4. Data Security# We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure.
5. Children’s Privacy# The App is not intended for children under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we become aware that we have collected such information, we will delete it promptly.
6. Changes to This Privacy Policy# We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy within the App or on our website. Your continued use of the App after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
7. Contact Us# If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
Email: piotereks@gmail.com By using the Free Parking App, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.
